title: ArtifactCodingInput
description: One coding unit: a matched PRE/POST open-text response pair for a single survey item from a single student.

item_id.description: Unique comparison item identifier matching ComparisonItem.id (e.g. 'comp-1b').

item_name.description: Human-readable label for the survey item (e.g. 'Brand Vision').

question_text.description: The survey question as shown to the student. Optional — included for context but must not change the coding outcome.

pre_response.description: The student's pre-survey open-text response. Must be a string. Numeric or null answers indicate this item should be excluded from semantic coding.
